items.title: Reflexivity is local on the primes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that reflexivity of a finite module over a Noetherian domain can be checked at all primes, or equivalently at all maximal ideals. The proof identifies the localisation of the natural map to the double dual at a prime with the corresponding natural map for the localised module over the localised ring, using that the double dual is computed by Hom out of a finitely presented module, and then applies the standard criterion that vanishing or invertibility of a module map can be tested locally at the primes.
